parked.spanish: Habla a hijos de Israel, y dirás a ellos: Varón o mujer, cuando hiciere maravilla a votar voto de nazir para nazir a Jehová,

findings.issue: נָזִיר is a common noun, not a proper name; "nazir" dumps the untranslated lemma instead of a Spanish common noun.
לְהַזִּיר is a hiphil infinitive (to separate/consecrate); "para nazir" repeats a noun and drops the verbal stem.
כִּי is only a conjunction (that/if/when/because); "cuando" selects the temporal sense.
One hiphil verb is split into "hacer" plus the noun "maravilla", which can be read as a separate marvel done in order to vow.

parked.spanish: Y hará el sacerdote uno a pecado y uno a holocausto, y expiará sobre él desde que pecó sobre el alma, y santificará su cabeza en el día aquel.

findings.issue: מֵאֲשֶׁר is preposition + relative (from what / that which); «desde que» locks a temporal since-the-time reading.
לְחַטָּאת is the feminine noun parallel to לְעֹלָה; «pecado» names the offense and leaves the offering sense unexpressed.

parked.spanish: Haga resplandecer Jehová sus faces a ti, y te haga gracia;

findings.issue: Qal jussive 3ms plus 2ms suffix is one verb of showing favor; Spanish splits it into the light verb haga and the noun gracia without a change of participants or stem force.
